item.title: Once again rubbish outside charity bin., 22nd November
item.description:
This problem has been going on for months. People place clothing and rubbish on and around the charity bin. The bags get ripped open by foxes and strewn everywhere. This time there is also a clear plastic bag containing a soiled nappy. I have been reporting this issue at least once a fortnight. There is also a sheet of acrylic on the floor next to the Yeep locker. When the rubbish is cleared this is left behind. It has been there since August.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Manor Close, Greater London
